newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures firmer on yen's weakness.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures firmer on yen's weakness.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Wednesday, lifted by private investors' short-covering, and reflecting the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.4 yen to 2.3 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark February was up 1.4 yen at 139.3 yen.
The market was spurred by technical factors and the currency market amid a lack of fresh incentives, they said.
"The yen's weakness stimulated some short-covering. But uncertainty over the spot expiry later this month, limited fresh buying," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
